parts.zh: M: 明天是我在这儿工作的最后一天
W: 啊，离职面谈。你期待吗？
M: 我也说不清自己是什么感觉
W: 在我看来，在离职面谈时把一股激动的真实想法倾泻出来
M: 让我猜猜。第二个好处是
W: 没错。但公司改进这一点的问题在于
M: 你现在让我重新考虑面谈时要透露些什么了
W: 你最初因为直抒己见而获得的即时满足
M: 对。也许去那些给雇主评分的网站发泄一下
W: 你可以这么做。也可以完全不参加面谈
M: 你们为什么提前结束了这次探险？

items.stem: What do we learn about the man from the conversation?

choices.text: He will tell the management how he really feels.
choices.zh: 他会告诉管理层他的真实感受。

choices.text: He will meet his new manager in two weeks.
choices.zh: 他将在两周后见他的新经理。

choices.text: He is going to attend a job interview.
choices.zh: 他将要参加一个工作面试。

choices.text: He is going to leave his present job.
choices.zh: 他将要离开他现在的工作。

items.stem: What does the woman think about the information gained from an exit interview?

choices.text: It should be kept private.
choices.zh: 应该保密。

choices.text: It should be carefully analyzed.
choices.zh: 应该仔细分析。

choices.text: It can be quite useful to senior managers.
choices.zh: 对高层管理者来说可能相当有用。

choices.text: It can improve interviewees' job prospects.
choices.zh: 可以改善面试者的工作前景。

items.stem: Why does the man want to rethink what he will say in the coming exit interview?

choices.text: It may leave a negative impression on the interviewer.
choices.zh: 可能会给面试官留下负面印象。

choices.text: It may adversely affect his future career prospects.
choices.zh: 可能会对他未来的职业前景产生不利影响。

choices.text: It may displease his immediate superiors.
choices.zh: 可能会让他的直属上级不高兴。

choices.text: It may do harm to his fellow employees.
choices.zh: 可能会对他的同事造成伤害。

items.stem: What does the man think he had better do?

choices.text: Prepare a comprehensive exit report.
choices.zh: 准备一份全面的离职报告。

choices.text: Do some practice for the exit interview.
choices.zh: 为离职面谈做一些练习。

choices.text: Network with his close friends to find a better employer.
choices.zh: 与他的密友建立联系以找到更好的雇主。

choices.text: Pour out his frustrations on a rate-your-employer website.
choices.zh: 在雇主评价网站上发泄他的不满。

items.stem: What does the man want Jane Forster to talk about?

choices.text: Her unsuccessful journey.
choices.zh: 她不成功的旅程。

choices.text: Her month-long expedition.
choices.zh: 她为期一个月的考察。

choices.text: Her latest documentary.
choices.zh: 她最新的纪录片。

choices.text: Her career as a botanist.
choices.zh: 她作为植物学家的职业生涯。

items.stem: Why does the woman describe her experience as "far from glamorous"?

choices.text: She had to live like a vegetarian.
choices.zh: 她不得不像素食者一样生活。

choices.text: She was caught in a hurricane.
choices.zh: 她遭遇了飓风。

choices.text: She had to endure many hardships.
choices.zh: 她不得不忍受许多艰难困苦。

choices.text: She suffered from water shortage.
choices.zh: 她遭受了缺水之苦。

items.stem: Why did the woman and those who went with her end their trip halfway?

choices.text: A hurricane was coming.
choices.zh: 飓风即将来临。

choices.text: A flood was approaching.
choices.zh: 洪水正在逼近。

choices.text: They had no more food in the canoe.
choices.zh: 他们的独木舟里没有食物了。

choices.text: They could no longer bear the humidity.
choices.zh: 他们无法再忍受湿度了。

items.stem: What does the woman think of the journey?

choices.text: It was memorable.
choices.zh: 令人难忘的。

choices.text: It was unbearable.
choices.zh: 难以忍受的。

choices.text: It was uneventful.
choices.zh: 平淡无奇的。

choices.text: It was fruitful.
choices.zh: 富有成果的。

items.stem: What does the passage say about the use of jargon terms by experts?

choices.text: It diminishes laymen's interest in science.
choices.zh: 它削弱了外行人对科学的兴趣。

choices.text: It ensures the accuracy of their arguments.
choices.zh: 它确保了他们论证的准确性。

choices.text: It makes their expressions more explicit.
choices.zh: 它使他们的表达更加明确。

choices.text: It hurts laymen's dignity and self-esteem.
choices.zh: 它伤害了外行人的尊严和自尊。

items.stem: What do researchers find about people reading scientific articles containing jargon terms?

choices.text: They can learn to communicate with scientists.
choices.zh: 他们可以学会与科学家交流。

choices.text: They tend to disbelieve the actual science.
choices.zh: 他们倾向于不相信真正的科学。

choices.text: They feel great respect towards scientists.
choices.zh: 他们对科学家感到非常尊敬。

choices.text: They will see the complexity of science.
choices.zh: 他们会看到科学的复杂性。

items.stem: What does Schulman suggest scientists do when communicating with the general public?

choices.text: Find appropriate topics.
choices.zh: 找到合适的话题。

choices.text: Stimulate their interest.
choices.zh: 激发他们的兴趣。

choices.text: Explain all the jargon terms.
choices.zh: 解释所有的术语。

choices.text: Do away with jargon terms.
choices.zh: 摒弃术语。

items.stem: What did Texas businessman Pattillo Higgins believe?

choices.text: The local gassy hill might start a huge fire.
choices.zh: 当地的含气山丘可能引发一场巨大的火灾。

choices.text: There was oil leakage along the Gulf Coast.
choices.zh: 墨西哥湾沿岸存在石油泄漏。

choices.text: The erupting gas might endanger local children.
choices.zh: 喷发的气体可能危及当地儿童。

choices.text: There were oil deposits below a local gassy hill.
choices.zh: 当地含气山丘下面有石油矿藏。

items.stem: What prevented Higgins' workers from digging a proper hole to get the oil?

choices.text: The massive gas underground.
choices.zh: 地下大量的气体。

choices.text: Their lack of the needed skill.
choices.zh: 他们缺乏所需的技能。

choices.text: The sand under the hill.
choices.zh: 山丘下的沙子。

choices.text: Their lack of suitable tools.
choices.zh: 他们缺乏合适的工具。

items.stem: What does the passage say about Captain Lucas' drilling method?

choices.text: It rendered many oil workers jobless.
choices.zh: 它使许多石油工人失业。

choices.text: It was not as effective as he claimed.
choices.zh: 它并不像他声称的那样有效。

choices.text: It gave birth to the oil drilling industry.
choices.zh: 它催生了石油钻探业。

choices.text: It was not popularized until years later.
choices.zh: 直到数年后它才得以推广。

items.stem: What do we learn about Texas oil industry boom?

choices.text: It radically transformed the state's economy.
choices.zh: 它彻底改变了该州的经济。

choices.text: It resulted in an oil surplus all over the world.
choices.zh: 它导致全世界石油过剩。

choices.text: It totally destroyed the state's rural landscape.
choices.zh: 它彻底破坏了该州的乡村景观。

choices.text: It ruined the state's cotton and beef industries.
choices.zh: 它毁掉了该州的棉花和牛肉产业。

items.stem: What is a primary cause of employee dissatisfaction according to recent research?

choices.text: Unsuitable jobs.
choices.zh: 不合适的工作。

choices.text: Bad managers.
choices.zh: 糟糕的管理者。

choices.text: Insufficient motivation.
choices.zh: 动力不足。

choices.text: Tough regulations.
choices.zh: 严苛的规章制度。

items.stem: What is one of the causes for poor management practices?

choices.text: Ineffective training.
choices.zh: 培训无效。

choices.text: Toxic company culture.
choices.zh: 有害的公司文化。

choices.text: Lack of regular evaluation.
choices.zh: 缺乏定期评估。

choices.text: Overburdening of managers.
choices.zh: 管理者负担过重。

items.stem: What do we learn about the study on job dissatisfaction?

choices.text: It collected feedback from both employers and employees.
choices.zh: 它收集了雇主和员工双方的反馈。

choices.text: It was conducted from frontline managers' point of view.
choices.zh: 它是从一线管理者的角度进行的。

choices.text: It provided meaningful clues to solving the problem.
choices.zh: 它为解决问题提供了有意义的线索。

choices.text: It was based only on the perspective of employees.
choices.zh: 它仅基于员工的视角。

items.stem: What does the passage say about the mining industry in Western Australia?

choices.text: It is seeing an automation revolution.
choices.zh: 该地区正在经历一场自动化革命。

choices.text: It is bringing prosperity to the region.
choices.zh: 该地区正在给这个地区带来繁荣。

choices.text: It is yielding an unprecedented profit.
choices.zh: 该地区正在产生前所未有的利润。

choices.text: It is expanding at an accelerating speed.
choices.zh: 该地区正在以加速的速度扩张。

items.stem: What is the impact of the digitization of the mining industry?

choices.text: It exhausts resources sooner.
choices.zh: 它更快地耗尽资源。

choices.text: It creates a lot of new jobs.
choices.zh: 它创造了大量新工作岗位。

choices.text: It causes conflicts between employers and employees.
choices.zh: 它导致雇主与雇员之间的冲突。

choices.text: It calls for the retraining of unskilled mining workers.
choices.zh: 它要求对非熟练矿工进行再培训。

items.stem: What is the attitude of workers' unions towards the introduction of new technology?

choices.text: They welcome it with open arms.
choices.zh: 他们张开双臂欢迎它。

choices.text: They will wait to see its effect.
choices.zh: 他们将等待观察它的效果。

choices.text: They are strongly opposed to it.
choices.zh: 他们强烈反对它。

choices.text: They accept it with reservations.
choices.zh: 他们有保留地接受它。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about traffic accidents in Thailand?

choices.text: Their cost to the nation's economy is incalculable.
choices.zh: 它们对国家经济造成的损失无法估量。

choices.text: They kill more people than any infectious disease.
choices.zh: 它们造成的死亡人数超过任何传染病。

choices.text: Their annual death rate is about twice that of the global average.
choices.zh: 它们的年死亡率约为全球平均水平的两倍。

choices.text: They have experienced a gradual decline since the year of 2017.
choices.zh: 自2017年以来它们经历了逐渐下降。

items.stem: What do we learn from an American institute's statistics regarding road deaths?

choices.text: They show a difference between rich and poor nations.
choices.zh: 它们显示了富国和穷国之间的差异。

choices.text: They don't reflect the changes in individual countries.
choices.zh: 它们没有反映各个国家的变化。

choices.text: They rise and fall from year to year.
choices.zh: 它们每年都有起伏。

choices.text: They are not as reliable as claimed.
choices.zh: 它们并不像声称的那样可靠。

items.stem: What is said about middle-income countries?

choices.text: Many of them have increasing numbers of cars on the road.
choices.zh: 它们中的许多国家道路上的汽车数量在增加。

choices.text: Many of them are following the example set by Thailand.
choices.zh: 它们中的许多国家正在效仿泰国树立的榜样。

choices.text: Many of them have seen a decline in road-death rates.
choices.zh: 它们中的许多国家道路死亡率出现了下降。

choices.text: Many of them are investing heavily in infrastructure.
choices.zh: 它们中的许多国家正在基础设施方面进行大量投资。

items.stem: What else could be done to reduce fatal road accidents in addition to safer roads?

choices.text: Foster better driving behavior.
choices.zh: 培养更好的驾驶行为。

choices.text: Provide better training for drivers.
choices.zh: 为驾驶员提供更好的培训。

choices.text: Abolish all outdated traffic rules.
choices.zh: 废除所有过时的交通规则。

choices.text: Impose heavier penalties on speeding.
choices.zh: 对超速施加更重的处罚。
